statement: The event-loop gap watchdog attributes the synchronous work behind node-0's raft-formation churn bursts (the 27.6% blocked / 14.6s-max-gap phase of the MovieLens live run) to named sync sections: the three formation sweep loops (control-plane rebind, raft-timing apply, replica registration) and the leader-activation path are wrapped with trackSyncSection so a fresh live run reports per-site totalMs/maxMs for these scopes, replacing the current 'unexplainedMs ~ gapMs' with an honest attribution - with zero behavior change (no timing, ordering, batching, or logic change), so the subsequent defer/batch cut targets the measured dominant burst rather than a guessed one.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Add only trackSyncSection/enterSyncSection/exitSyncSection wrappers and the site-name constants. Do not change timing, ordering, batching, deferral, election logic, rebind logic, registration logic, or any control flow. The wrapped functions must return/throw identically; no throttle, no flag, no new dependency beyond the existing event-loop-gap-watchdog.

Before any live run, prove with a deterministic test that each new sync section is entered and exited around its sweep (the registry records the site, totalMs accumulates, exclusive nesting with an inner site does not double-count), and that a wrapped function's return value and thrown error are unchanged. Red-on-revert for at least one scope.

Do not change the event-loop-gap-watchdog's budget thresholds, gap detection, sampling profiler enablement, or the existing cdc_update_row_fetch/cdc_insert_row_fetch sites. New site names follow the snake_case convention and lazily register.
Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, or live scenario semantics.
